notes: Modified cash basis village (basis recorded as cash). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column of the governmental funds revenues/expenditures statement (p5); utility lines from the proprietary funds total column (p7; Electric, Water, Sewer, Apartments are accrual). Beginning/ending cash recorded as the governmental fund balances the statement rolls forward (1,716,987 -> 1,723,848); total assets on p4 are 1,724,351 less 503 employee withholdings. Check: 1,716,987 + 483,824 - 493,474 + 238,079 - 221,568 = 1,723,848. Transfers out = Transfers out 121,568 + Transfer to Care Center 100,000 (the Care Center is the village's component unit and reports 100,000 as Village support). Business-type: 2,739,689 + 983,660 - 1,139,408 - 116,511 = 2,467,430. Governmental transfers net in 116,511 matches enterprise transfers out 116,511 (p7). Statement of cash flows covers proprietary funds on a different basis; proprietary left null (not GAAP-basis). Attempt 2 (re-check): balance sheet governmental lines now from the governmental funds Balance Sheet - Modified Cash Basis (p4, Total Governmental Funds column; fund balance by classification), since its totals (assets 1,724,351, liabilities 503, fund balance 1,723,848) equal the government-wide governmental activities column (p1); business-type lines stay from the Statement of Net Position (p1, Business-type Activities); printed totals are the p1 Total primary government column (6,130,317 = 1,939,039 + 4,191,278). Intergovernmental 160,644 (General 48,183, Street 112,461) is not broken down anywhere in the report, so it stays one state aid line. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p10) not entered, since the General Fund departments schedule (p14-15) is the more detailed one with identical totals (228,604 / 306,508); Park/Library etc. recorded per department column. Salaries line includes taxes and benefits. Detail 'Other revenues' and 'Other expenses' lines are unexplained and flagged for review. Attempt 3 (charges-for-services re-check): statement 'Charges for services' 11,954 split per the General Fund departments schedule into Recreation Fees 4,973 (Park, p14) and Cemetery Fees 6,981 (Cemetery, p15); 'Rental and fees' 3,625 (Community Building only) -> Rentals (review: label mixes fees); proprietary 'Sales' 947,861 (Electric/Water/Sewer) -> Utility Charges; proprietary 'Other revenue' 29,163 not explained anywhere -> other (review). Detail lines recategorized to match. Read pages 1-15 of 15
